Gnosis Interpretation
MOVE below 80 is calm, 80-120 is moderate uncertainty, and 150+ is high stress; 97.87 is moderate. SOFR measures secured overnight funding, not unsecured bank funding. NFCI below zero indicates looser-than-average broad financial conditions; -0.496 is the latest returned weekly observation for Oct 16, not a live reading. The Oct 23 NFCI observation was not present in the returned series.

Legend: High = higher expected volatility; Medium = moderate; Low = lower. Qualitative ES/rates assessment only; not an official publisher rating, probability, directional prediction, or trade signal.
Fed & Policy Watch
  • The FOMC meets Oct 27-28. The Federal Reserve Board calendar gives a 2:00 PM meeting entry and a 2:30 PM press conference on Wed Oct 28; both carry High impact under the local classifier.
  • Tomorrow's 8:30 AM GDP advance estimate and Personal Income and Outlays/PCE Deflator are independently listed for Oct 29 by BEA and the New York Fed; dates and times agree. The BEA schedule places GDP second estimate and Corporate Profits on Nov 25 at 8:30 AM.
  • Selected Board statistical releases were checked against each item's own day list: H.15 today and Thu Oct 29 at 4:15 PM; H.4.1 Thu Oct 29 at 4:30 PM; H.8 Fri Oct 30 at 4:15 PM. The Board calendar does not schedule H.6 on Oct 28; its listed Oct date is 27 and has elapsed.
  • Chicago Fed schedules NFCI for today, week ending Oct 23. That Oct 23 value was not returned in the Chicago Fed series; latest returned value is -0.496 for week ending Oct 16.
Omissions and Watch
  • Coverage is selected, not exhaustive, and limited to checked primary sources. BLS.gov was not requested; BLS release dates and ET times use the New York Fed Economic Indicators Calendar. CPI and PPI are distinct: the checked calendar places CPI on Nov 10 (High) and PPI on Nov 13 (Medium); Employment Situation is Nov 6 (High).
  • Calendar conflict check: BEA and New York Fed agree on Oct 29, 8:30 AM, for advance GDP and September Personal Income/Outlays (PCE); BEA also confirms GDP second estimate and Corporate Profits Nov 25, 8:30 AM. No conflicting dates were found in these checks. No remaining events at or before the 00:30:24 ET cutoff are carried into the calendar.
  • The EIA petroleum schedule lists the standard Wednesday 10:30 AM release but did not provide date-specific confirmation for Oct 28; the natural-gas page similarly lists the standard Thursday schedule without a date-specific Oct 29 row. Those recurring dates are omitted rather than inferred. Verified holiday-adjusted EIA dates are listed above. No energy-release cause for the overnight WTI move is inferred.
  • Overnight WTI is $101.33, +1.43% from Tuesday's completed generic futures bar; monitor energy sensitivity without assigning a catalyst. No verified unscheduled policy or geopolitical watch item from this run; this is not a full risk review.
  • Chicago Fed CFNAI was listed for Oct 26 and is elapsed. New York Fed calendars note dates and times are tentative. No exchange-specific market-structure item or product-hours review was verified; confirm contract, exchange hours, liquidity and event updates before execution.
  • Yahoo is a single-source vendor quote for the snapshot; futures bars are generic continuous-series quotes, not official settlement prices. The local classifier self-test passed. Unmatched events are marked provisional Medium, not silently treated as Low.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
SPY's Tuesday vendor close gained 0.56%; ES=F was 0.05% above Tuesday's completed session in the early Wednesday overnight quote. The official 10Y close eased 1 bp to 4.99%, while MOVE 97.87 remains in the moderate-uncertainty band. The FOMC decision and press conference are today; GDP and PCE are Thursday at 8:30 AM. Expect event sensitivity, not a directional conclusion: monitor live yields, volatility, liquidity and the selected contract. Scenario framing only, not a trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess if ES sustains a range break without confirmation from live Treasury yields, volatility and market depth; if the selected contract's hours differ; or if official event schedules change. No unsupported levels or targets are supplied. Reconfirm live quotes, auction/event updates and contract details before execution.
